body: Worker rule (Termal::BarA2, 2026-10-29, my own miss on w-c205 slice B round 4, freeze 1f56bc91; from Fable2 #1090). Before any refreeze, if a change replaces a type or changes its derives (for example Option<String> replaced by Option<NewStruct>), grep BOTH src/ and src/tests/ for every use of the type and of the field or tuple that carries it. Look especially for assert_eq!, ==, sorting, hashing and serde. Cost of skipping it: round 4 swapped `entries: Vec<(EngramOwedBind, Option<String>)>` for `Option<EngramOwedBindSettled>` with only #[derive(Debug)]. Two existing tests did `assert_eq!(line, &None)`, so the cold --list precheck failed with E0369. That spent a named Cargo GO slot, forced refreeze 8c8e29a4, and needed a full round-5 review pair, because the review pair binds to the exact tree. Typeck reports all type errors in one pass, but borrow checking runs only after typeck passes.
